story.iWant: parallel document ingestion with optimized API usage
story.soThat: I can ingest 10 PDFs in 30-45 minutes instead of 4-5 hours (6-10x speedup)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC1: Parallel Document Processing (2x speedup) - [ ] Implement `ingest_documents_parallel()` function that processes N documents concurrently - [ ] Default concurrency: 2 documents (configurable via `INGESTION_PARALLEL_DOCS` env var) - [ ] Memory-safe: Docling uses 2-4GB RAM per 160-page PDF, so 2 parallel = 4-8GB - [ ] Graceful error handling: One document failure doesn't abort entire batch - [ ] Cross-document unit cache shared between parallel workers
### AC2: Rule-Based Unit Pre-Filter (80% API reduction for units) - [ ] Implement `infer_unit_from_rules()` that handles common patterns WITHOUT API calls - [ ] Patterns to cover (80%+ of financial documents): Revenue/EBITDA -> Meur, Margin -> %, /ton -> EUR/ton, Volume -> kton, Days -> days, Headcount -> FTE - [ ] LLM fallback ONLY for table chunks (per user preference) - [ ] Track stats: `rule_inferred_count` vs `llm_inferred_count`
### AC3: Cross-Document Unit Cache (30% additional API reduction) - [ ] Implement global `UNIT_CACHE: dict[str, str]` keyed by metric name - [ ] Cache persists across all documents in a batch - [ ] If metric "EBITDA IFRS" was inferred as "Meur" for doc 1, reuse for docs 2-10 - [ ] Add `unit_source` field: "rule", "cached", "llm"
### AC4: Skip Chunk Metadata Extraction at Ingestion (90% API reduction) - [ ] Add `skip_metadata: bool = True` parameter to `ingest_pdf()` - [ ] When `skip_metadata=True`, mark chunks with `metadata_extracted = False` - [ ] Eliminates 400 API calls per document - [ ] Add configuration: `SKIP_INGESTION_METADATA=true` (default)
### AC5: Query-Time Metadata Enrichment (Strategy C) - [ ] Implement `enrich_results_with_metadata()` in `raglite/retrieval/search.py` - [ ] Called AFTER retrieval, only for top-K results (5-10 chunks) - [ ] Parallel API calls for all unenriched results - [ ] Timeout: 2.5 seconds (configurable via `QUERY_TIME_METADATA_TIMEOUT`) - [ ] Graceful degradation: Return results without metadata if timeout exceeded - [ ] Add feature flag: `QUERY_TIME_METADATA_ENABLED=true` (default)
### AC6: Progress Reporting - [ ] Log document-level progress: "Ingesting document 3/10: report_Q3.pdf" - [ ] Log batch-level timing: "Batch complete: 10 docs in 42 minutes (4.2 min avg)" - [ ] Log API call stats: "Unit inference: 45 rule-based, 12 LLM calls" - [ ] Return summary statistics from `ingest_documents_parallel()`
### AC7: Validation - [ ] All existing unit tests pass - [ ] Unit tests for rule-based unit inference (10+ test cases) - [ ] Integration test: Ingest 3 test PDFs in parallel, verify all chunks stored correctly - [ ] Performance test: 10-PDF batch completes in <45 minutes (measured on M1 Mac) - [ ] Query latency test: hybrid_search with enrichment completes in <3 seconds

constraint.rule: This is a ~600-800 line MVP. NO custom base classes, factories, or abstract layers. ONE level of indirection maximum. If you need a helper function, call it directly.

Technology stack is LOCKED. ONLY use libraries listed in docs/architecture/5-technology-stack-definitive.md. NEVER add SDKs, frameworks, or libraries not documented. If a library isn't in the tech stack table, ASK FIRST.

Use SDKs EXACTLY as documented in official documentation. NO custom wrappers, NO simplified interfaces, NO convenience layers. If SDK documentation says client.search(), use client.search() - don't wrap it.
All I/O operations MUST use async/await pattern. Use asyncio.Semaphore for controlled concurrency (matches existing codebase pattern in unit_inference.py).
Specific exceptions with context. Graceful degradation: Query-time enrichment timeout should return results without metadata rather than fail.
8GB max for M1 Mac development = 2 concurrent 160-page PDFs. Docling uses 2-4GB RAM per document.
All database operations must use SafetyGuard class from raglite/shared/safety.py. Tests MUST use APP_ENV=test and will FAIL if they detect production ports (6333/5432).

Type hints for ALL functions. Google-style docstrings for ALL public functions. Structured logging with extra={} for context. Follow patterns from docs/architecture/6-complete-reference-implementation.md.

interface.name: ingest_document
interface.signature: async def ingest_document(doc_path: str, skip_metadata: bool = True) -> DocumentMetadata
interface.description: Current ingestion entry point. Returns DocumentMetadata with document_id, page_count, chunk_count. Will be wrapped by ingest_documents_parallel() for batch processing.

interface.name: extract_chunk_metadata
interface.description: LLM-based metadata extraction. Called during ingestion (400 API calls/doc). Target for skip_metadata parameter and query-time enrichment reuse.

interface.name: search_documents
interface.signature: async def search_documents(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> list[QueryResult]
interface.description: Vector search returning top-K results. Target for post-retrieval metadata enrichment (AC5).

interface.name: Settings (Pydantic BaseSettings)
interface.description: Configuration management. Need to add: ingestion_parallel_docs (int = 2), skip_ingestion_metadata (bool = True), query_time_metadata_enabled (bool = True), query_time_metadata_timeout (float = 2.5), unit_inference_llm_tables_only (bool = True).

interface.name: MISTRAL_SEMAPHORE
interface.description: Global semaphore for rate limiting Mistral API calls (max 10 concurrent). Pattern to reuse for parallel document processing.

tests.standards: Testing follows pytest patterns with async support (pytest-asyncio). All tests consolidated in tests/ directory with clear separation: tests/unit/ for fast tests with no external dependencies, tests/integration/ for end-to-end flows requiring Qdrant/PostgreSQL. Tests use APP_ENV=test to avoid production database conflicts. Target coverage: 80%+ for critical paths. Mock external dependencies (Docling, Claude API, Mistral API) in unit tests. Integration tests validate full pipelines with real databases.

ideas.idea: Test parallel ingestion with 3 PDFs, verify all chunks stored correctly in Qdrant and PostgreSQL. Mock Docling to avoid slow PDF processing. Verify cross-document unit cache shared between workers.

Unit tests for rule-based unit inference: test_revenue_metrics (Revenue -> Meur), test_margin_metrics (Margin -> %), test_volume_metrics (Volume -> kton), test_per_ton_metrics (/ton -> EUR/ton), test_headcount_metrics (Headcount -> FTE), test_no_match_returns_none.
Unit tests for cross-document cache: test_cache_populates_on_first_inference, test_cache_reused_across_documents. Verify cache key normalization (lowercase, stripped).
Unit tests for skip_metadata parameter: test_skip_metadata_true_marks_unenriched, test_skip_metadata_false_extracts_metadata. Verify metadata_extracted flag in chunks.

Unit tests for query-time enrichment: test_enrich_results_with_metadata_parallel, test_enrichment_timeout_graceful_degradation, test_enrichment_feature_flag_disabled. Integration test: verify query latency with enrichment <3 seconds.
Integration test: verify progress logging appears in structured logs. Verify BatchIngestionResult contains success/failure counts and timing stats.

Performance test: benchmark 10-PDF batch time (target <45 min on M1 Mac). Report API call reduction statistics (rule vs cache vs LLM). Verify no regressions in existing test suite (109 tests passing).
